objective: Implement deterministic provider-scoped Order Book analytics for spread, top-N depth and normalized depth imbalance with strict book-integrity, point-in-time and Forex coverage boundaries.
scope: Define governed Order Book source taxonomy for venue, broker and ECN books
Define deterministic bid/ask level and snapshot contracts
Require positive price/size, unique prices and strict bid-descending/ask-ascending ordering
Fail closed on locked or crossed books
Compute best bid/ask, mid, absolute spread and spread basis points
Compute deterministic comparable top-N bid and ask depth
Compute signed normalized depth imbalance in integer basis points
Require point-in-time event/as-of semantics and trusted provenance
Require spot-FX books to remain broker/ECN/provider scoped
out_of_scope: Funding, Open Interest, liquidation or crowding models (P09-F)
Signal fusion, calibrated trade probability, Risk approval or broker/exchange execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P09 Order Book source
Positive bid/ask levels with strict canonical sorting validate
Duplicate or out-of-order levels fail closed
Future event time relative to as-of fails closed
Spot-FX venue/global/consolidated book claims fail closed
Best bid/ask, mid and spread are deterministic
Comparable top-N depth requires enough levels on both sides
Depth imbalance is deterministic and bounded to [-10000,10000] bps
Snapshot identity is deterministic and content-sensitive
Book/metrics contracts expose no order/recommendation authority
P09-D evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No broker/exchange execution adapter is imported
No credential or network access is required
No global/consolidated spot-FX book is synthesized
rollback: Revert P09-D order-book module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and active-state reconciliation. P09-A/B/C remain canonical and no production/trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Order Book snapshot and metrics contracts implemented
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
